response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but the role's core mandatory requirements are not met: professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint in 2014–2015 (and a thesis project on Linux, not Windows), there is no evidence of SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets domain exposure. His background is heavily weighted toward web/full-stack work in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, which does not align with a Windows C++ capital-markets consulting engagement.
strengths: Deep systems/low-latency experience (DLang, async I/O, high-throughput services)
Strong engineering fundamentals: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, and mentoring/teaching
Broad polyglot experience with some C/C++ and Java exposure
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ work, a decade ago, not on Windows platforms
No fixed income, derivatives, investment banking, or capital-markets domain experience
SQL experience appears general (MySQL/MongoDB), with no SQL Server or Oracle evidence

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering and low-latency systems background
